personal_statement: As a Senior R&D Engineer – AI for Simulation Tools, I thrive on solving complex technical challenges and shaping the next generation of mechanical simulation tools. With a strong foundation in software development and AI, I'm excited to blend agentic AI advancements with engineering simulation software. My experience spans academic, research, and industry environments, allowing me to bring a rigorous analytical approach and commitment to excellence. I'm self-driven, continuously seeking opportunities to expand my skill set and contribute to a culture of agility and improvement. Whether working independently or as part of a distributed team, I bring a collaborative spirit and drive to deliver impactful AI solutions.
